descriptions.es: Escribe la entrada del CHANGELOG del trabajo de una tarea: lee el diff de la rama, agrupa los cambios como los necesita quien lee las notas de la versión y edita CHANGELOG.md bajo Unreleased.

definition.name: changelog-writer
definition.description: Writes the CHANGELOG entry for the work of a task: reads the branch diff, groups the changes the way a reader of the release notes needs them, and edits CHANGELOG.md under Unreleased.
